outcome: infant neurodevelopment (assessed by Ages and Stages Questionnaire Third Edition low score)
cohort: Infants born to mothers exposed to SARS-CoV-2 or mRNA-COVID-19 vaccine during pregnancy, or unexposed to either the virus or the vaccine were enrolled from 2021 to 2023.
finding: In utero exposure to SARS-CoV-2 or mRNA-COVID-19 vaccine was not associated with an increased risk of a low neurodevelopmental score at 12 months after birth compared to unexposed infants.
